metadata.title: 4 Hours with NVIDIA VP Ming-Yu Liu: Kung Fu, Cosmos 3, Open World Models, Jensen, and Not Needing to Beat Every Opponent
metadata.guest_role: Vice President of Research, NVIDIA · Cosmos / world-model lead

conclusion: NVIDIA research VP Ming-Yu Liu sits for four hours a month after Jensen's China trip: Cosmos 3 as an open world model for Physical AI, a 20-year arc inside a chip company, and Jensen's GSD label. He treats other labs as partners — you don't need to defeat opponents — and open-sources model, trainer, and some synthetic data while frontier labs close up. OpenAI's Sora-to-coding pivot is the contrast. Classmates went to MediaTek and TSMC; he wants Thor, Isaac, and Cosmos to help robot/hands work in China rather than fight every customer.
background: Zhang's long interview with NVIDIA VP of Research Ming-Yu Liu — NCTU wireless comms in Hsinchu, then US PhD after seeing 0-to-1 work he wasn't doing in protocols. Inside NVIDIA he is described as an engineering leader more than a typical researcher. Topics: Cosmos 3, kung fu lineage (Xu Ji / Liu Yunqiao / Li Shuwen), Physical AI versus consumer video, and how a systems company does research when the product is infrastructure.
important_facts: Cosmos 3 is NVIDIA's open world model: they open-source the model, the training framework, and part of the synthetic data, and say a better downstream model should also be open. Path ran Transfer (make sim video more real) → Reason → Cosmo-style pixel-change ≈ action-change. Personal mandate is Physical AI — chores, dangerous labor, dexterous hands he noticed more on this China trip — not competing with Sora-like consumer video.

Org contrast: frontier labs have gone closed, papers hiding the key bits. Liu: NVIDIA was a design house that needed partners, so 'take care of others' is industrial structure, not a slogan. Jensen's one-line on him is GSD. OpenAI/Anthropic-class labs productized research; NVIDIA research must serve Thor, Isaac, and developer tools. He reads OpenAI's Sora de-emphasis as a coding-agent token-volume bet (24–48h agents vs a minute of chat) — defend everywhere and strength thins.

Bio: NCTU Hsinchu wireless classmates → MediaTek/TSMC; he left for US PhD because protocol speedups felt incremental versus 0-to-1 US work. Early NVIDIA pitch was data-driven graphics (novel-in, movie-out) that traditional pipelines cannot staff. Kung fu since 18 under Xu Ji in the Li Shuwen / Cangzhou line — the same long-horizon craft metaphor as world models. 20-year quest: stay inside a massive infrastructure company and still ship open science.

mental_model.name: Open World Model × Partner-Not-Opponent × Physical-AI Mandate
mental_model.components: Publish weights, trainer, and some data so the Physical AI stack compounds. Refuse opponent framing because NVIDIA's original design-house P&L required customers to win. Put research behind robots/hands/sim, not a closed consumer video race. Accept that labs will pivot (Sora→coding) when token economics shift.
mental_model.application: NVDA is a Physical AI tools vendor (Thor/Isaac/Cosmos) as much as a GPU monopoly. Track whether Cosmos stays actually open when customers ship better models. TSMC/MediaTek remain the classmate industrial base. Fade 'NVIDIA must beat OpenAI at Sora' takes — Liu explicitly will not fight every front.

key_insights.view: You don't need to defeat your opponents.
key_insights.question: Why open-source a world model inside NVIDIA?
key_insights.answer: A better model built on their work should also be open; partners, not opponents. Design-house history makes customer success the P&L.

key_insights.view: Physical AI is the assigned quest.
key_insights.question: Why not chase Sora?
key_insights.answer: Hands, chores, dangerous labor, Thor/Isaac. OpenAI's coding pivot shows even labs cannot defend everywhere.

key_insights.question: What kind of researcher survives at NVIDIA?
key_insights.answer: An engineering leader who ships Cosmos inside a systems company — not a paper-only identity.

top_investment_implications.thesis: Cosmos/Thor/Isaac extend the stack into Physical AI while staying the partner layer — medium
Classmate industrial base and the foundry behind any Physical AI silicon NVIDIA does not keep in-house — low

golden_quotes: You don't need to defeat your opponents
Everything we do is open source
